# Sandesh Kumar Gupta

> Cybersecurity student and researcher in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India (also associated with Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh). Also written as Sandesh Gupta. Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech CSE) in Computer Science and Engineering at GLA University (2024-2028), with a specialization in Cybersecurity, Ethical Hacking and AI. Focus: eBPF and Linux kernel security, machine-learning threat detection, VAPT and CTFs. Currently a Cyber Security Intern at the Amroha Police Cyber Security Internship Program (APCSIP-2026).

This is a one-page portfolio. Sections: projects, skills, about, certifications, contact.
